evals.prompt: Start a multi-phase refactoring project that needs to survive context changes.
evals.expected_output: Orient by reading global rules, mapping the project with graphify (or docs/configs where graphify does not apply), reading applicable skills, .agents/MEMORY.md, handoffs, approval_mode, and active sessions; create one timestamped session directory under .agents/brain/sessions/active/ with meta/, implementation_plan.md, tasks.md, and walkthrough.md before editing.
expectations: Reads global rules, project map (graphify or docs/configs), and applicable skills before creating the session
Checks .agents/MEMORY.md, approval_mode, and active sessions before creating a new session
Creates implementation_plan.md, tasks.md, and walkthrough.md under .agents/brain/sessions/active/
Creates goal.md only if requested or required

evals.prompt: Mark a Maestro session DONE after fixing all listed tasks.
evals.expected_output: Verify every acceptance criterion against exact final artifacts, re-read changed non-code files in full, update walkthrough.md with verification evidence, and set State: DONE.
expectations: Verifies all acceptance criteria against exact final artifacts
Records verification commands and evidence in walkthrough.md
Marks tasks [x] only after artifact verification

evals.prompt: Start work on a new feature in a project whose .agents/brain/sessions/active holds two DONE Maestro sessions and one EXECUTING Maestro session untouched for 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Before creating the new Maestro session, run sessions.py status and stale --apply: the DONE sessions are archived, the idle one is closed as ABANDONED and archived, evidence files move to ~/.agents/evidence, INDEX.md lists all three, and the user gets a one-line closure report.
expectations: ls .agents/brain/sessions/active shows only the new Maestro session
no png, jpg, webp, log, or zip file remains under .agents/brain/sessions/archive

evals.prompt: Park the mobile money integration work until the provider sends sandbox credentials, then finish the active dashboard session.
evals.expected_output: Run sessions.py dormant on the integration session with its reason and a plain-word wake condition about sandbox credentials, finish and close the dashboard session, then run sessions.py wake-check, judge the plain-word condition from evidence, and ask the user before waking the integration session.
expectations: Parks the integration session with sessions.py dormant and a --wake condition instead of closing or abandoning it
Completes and closes the active dashboard session before checking dormant sessions
Runs sessions.py wake-check after no active session remains open
Asks the user for permission before running sessions.py wake

evals.prompt: Persist approval_mode=true for this repository and inspect session status and dormant wake readiness.
evals.expected_output: Runs sessions.py approval set true, records .agents/brain/approvals.json and ~/.agents/steward/approvals.tsv, displays approval_mode: true in status, and marks condition-met dormant sessions ready for auto-wake.
expectations: python3 maestro/scripts/sessions.py approval set true updates .agents/brain/approvals.json
python3 maestro/scripts/sessions.py status prints approval_mode: true
